title: Alex Dietrich on ufologists enjoying anticipation
summary: Michael Shurmer tells of Alex Dietrich on ufologists enjoying anticipation, about 2004 at Off San Diego (Nimitz, 2004), and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: I'll give the last word to Dietrich who witnessed the 2004 UAP incident from the USS Nimttz fighter jet as I think it well sums up 75 years of ufologist search for aliens.

plain: A researcher, Michael Shurmer, described in the episode as a top skeptic, debated a podcast host, Jesse Michels, in 2026. To close, he gave the last word to Alex Dietrich, who in 2004 saw a UAP, the government's term for an unidentified object, from a fighter jet flying from the aircraft carrier USS Nimitz off San Diego. Shurmer says her remark that ufologists, people who hunt for UFOs, enjoy the anticipation sums up 75 years of searching for aliens.
